rules.inputTick: Each step call advances one tick; frames are applied on that tick; input sequence contiguous; multiple FLAPs in one call apply one impulse.
rules.canonical: Recursively sorted ASCII object keys; arrays preserve order; safe integers only; no absent or null runtime fields.

generation.patternSelection: fmix32(uint32(seed XOR imul(floor(pipeIndex/4)+1,0x9e3779b9))) modulo catalog length; index modulo 4 selects gap
generation.cursor: rng cursor advances by uint32(0x9e3779b9) for each generated pipe, and once per evaluated pipe index >=2 spawn opportunity, including NONE and capacity suppression

rules.spawn: Filter eligibility/spacing, cumulative half-open NONE-first buckets; total zero after filtering means NONE; one opportunity per pipe. Existing items move once; newly spawned items stay aligned with their post-movement pipe. Capacity suppresses spawn without retry.
rules.ordering: input/integration/world move; lethal collision; if alive score ordered pipes; generate; spawn opportunities in pipe order; collect in stored array order; cleanup. Lethal tick does not move/collect items or generate.
rules.configIdentity: dd-v1-default iff config content equals current DEFAULT_CONFIG. Otherwise dd-v1-config: followed by canonical JSON of {configuration,patterns}. No hash collision and no implicit historical registry. Pre-release fixture replaces obsolete never-released tuning.
rules.limits: Counter increments checked before Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-1. Object window stays local; no accumulated distance coordinate. Unsupported configs are experiments, not guaranteed reachable.

reachabilityWitness.controller: first tick FLAP; thereafter FLAP when previous y>=333000 and vy>0
reachabilityWitness.note: Closed vertical orbit lies strictly inside every supported default gap; establishes a default-physics surviving strategy across arbitrary catalog transitions, not all player states or custom configs.
